generate_fake_structures: generate fake atomic structures with LJ-like energies and repulsive forces from a FakeDatasetConfig
create_fake_dataset: create a single fake ASE database from a FakeDatasetConfig and write it to disk
create_fake_benchmark_dataset: generate all 5 UMA benchmark datasets with production-like system sizes in a temp directory
configure_fake_dataset: configure a FakeDatasetConfig with name, system size range, energy and force standard deviations
get_normalization_constants: get normalization constants for energy and forces from a FakeDatasetConfig instance
